review: 5 of 5: playable journey and whole-map quality gate
method: Read source/runtime/layout and cross-reviewed native inventories, genuine baseline captures and the other three completed audits. No engine launches or game input were performed by this reviewer. Native behavioral reproductions are explicitly marked where still required.
summary: The journey has real interaction foundations, but several success/availability states are disconnected from their promised physical outcomes. The existing93-check pass cannot certify the whole map because it begins after check-in and does not cover these negative paths.

findings.title: Automatic proximity doors override the room access policy before animation
evidence: airport_runtime.physics: automatic doors assign target solely from pawn distance, then interpolate fraction.
airport_rooms24.physics calls its base first, then assigns the access24 target. The following base call overwrites that policy before moving the door again.
Both screening entry leaves are automatic and access24=checked_in; both exit leaves are automatic and access24=security. Manual act denial does not govern their automatic motion.
findings.correction: Evaluate proximity AND access state once, before interpolation. Put the access policy in the authoritative door target function; remove the competing post-animation assignment.
acceptance: Approach screening entry without checking in: both leaves remain closed and block walking.
With a ticket, entry opens normally. Approach exit before completing the lane: it stays closed.
After full valid screening, exit opens; no frame or slow-frame condition briefly opens a denied leaf.

findings.title: Walking mode has a global invisible zero-height floor and stale outdoor terminal coverage
evidence: floor_at_source adds the Cabin deck at z0 whenever abs(feet_z)<.28, without testing x/y against the cabin footprint.
When no candidate exists it returns the previous feet height/name rather than a bounded physical floor or gravity behavior.

Clarity37 floors still include Compact terminal rect[-49,-14,-22,18] and Service ramp rect[-18.4,-15.6,18,53], even though the revised north-east region is exterior. Audit3 separately confirms the obsolete bridge/service platform context.
findings.correction: Bound the cabin fallback to its actual translated deck; derive terminal floor regions from current occupied room footprints, with intentional apron/ramp floors only. Decide an explicit behavior for leaving physical walkable surfaces; never silently preserve a floating deck height.
acceptance: Perimeter sweep includes positions outside every room and bridge: no phantom z0 support appears over exterior grass/void.
Both WC/security envelope breaches are sealed geometrically and do not rely on a hidden floor to conceal them.
Gallery and lower aircraft hold still preserve correct eye height and use only their connected surfaces.

findings.title: Security equipment reports a screening process that is not connected to baggage clearance
evidence: airport_runtime.act(scanner/security) sets screening_armed=True and says baggage screening active.
A repository search finds screening_armed only at that assignment; no simulation or validation consumes it.
airport_journey22.physics grants security solely from checked_in plus full portal traversal. It does not check carried baggage, tray use, a scanner result or the supposedly armed state.
findings.correction: Create one coherent prepare/load/scan/collect policy. Keep checked-baggage drop optional, but require any carried cabin bag to pass the scanner before person clearance; allow an unencumbered passenger to traverse normally. Either make the scanner control meaningful or remove the false Start screening promise.
acceptance: A checked-in passenger carrying an unscanned bag cannot obtain security_cleared merely by walking the detector.
A bag placed on the scanner belt visibly passes through, is marked scanned only after valid transit, and can be collected.
Empty-handed screening remains simple; duplicate press/traverse actions cannot award false completion.

findings.title: A bag is irrevocably registered before the promised physical transfer occurs
evidence: airport_journey22.physics accepts any unheld supported bag anywhere inside a bag-drop rectangle, sets bag_accepted, appends the bag to checked_bags and registered_bags.
act(pickup) then rejects retrieval of a registered bag, although the verified belt ends against a wall and there is no transfer/collection stage.
The earlier journey QA checks a bag is a native body on the belt; it does not verify its onward destination or end-of-belt handling.
findings.correction: Separate loaded, screening/in-transfer and safely-transferred states. Complete registration only after the bag crosses the guarded hatch/transfer endpoint into the real backstage system. Provide recovery for stalled or cancelled transfer before that point.
acceptance: Follow one real suitcase from player hand through each belt and physical wall opening to supported backstage storage.
No accepted bag remains pushing against a wall, falls off an unsupported end or becomes irretrievable mid-transfer.
Ticket bag count and progress messages correspond to the actual completed transfer, not merely belt contact.

findings.title: Lavatory occupied indicators do not provide an occupied-door lock
evidence: airport_runtime.act(slide) toggles door target regardless of occupancy. For fixed releases it calculates occupied only to choose red/green material.
Closing using inside_release=True makes the indicator red; an outside_release target can immediately toggle the same door open because there is no persistent occupied/locked gate.
The WC interactions have fixed_release/inside_release but no access24 or independent privacy state.
findings.correction: Maintain explicit occupied/locked state per cubicle. Inside close/lock sets occupied; outside normal release respects it; inside release always permits exit. Keep indicators synchronized with the real state, with an explicit emergency release only if intended.
acceptance: Close/lock from inside: outside normal control cannot open the door and displays occupied.
Inside release opens safely and restores vacant.
Both indicators agree; close/open, interrupted animation and repeated clicks cannot create a misleading colour state.

findings.title: A08 presents a boarding action even though it only supplies information
evidence: The A08 interaction has kind=boarding and title=Gate information, gate=A08.
airport_clarity26 maps every boarding target to the Boarding hint. Clarity26/SourceAssets/hud26.py defines that hint as E Scan boarding pass.
airport_runtime.act rejects gates other than A07 and merely says SA107 boards at Gate A07.
findings.correction: Represent the A08 station as a context-specific information action with the correct prompt and useful gate/flight status. Reserve boarding-pass scan prompts for an actual enabled boarding action.
acceptance: At A08 the hint says information/status, not scan boarding pass.
Using it explains the relevant status and route to A07 without denial/error feedback.
A07 still validates the pass and opens its real bridge entry.

findings.title: Coffee service is a success cue without a serving interaction or outcome
evidence: The current visible espresso station has a vending target titled Coffee service.
airport_runtime.act(vending) plays GateOpen, prints Refreshments ready and emits Refreshment selected; it creates no drink, updates no machine/service state and offers no pickup.
Modeled café cups/food remain static visual detail. This limitation is documented in the previous README, but the player-facing service action still promises an outcome.
findings.correction: Provide one honest, bounded service loop: dispense a cup to a supported pickup position and allow the player to hold/use or return it. Otherwise remove the functional service prompt and present the station as clear scenery. Avoid using the boarding-open cue for coffee.
acceptance: A service request has a visible result at a reachable supported pickup position, with correct interaction and sound feedback.
Repeated use cannot spawn intersecting/unbounded objects.
A purely decorative station never reports a completed service action.

findings.title: Queue service and the player call are driven by list timing rather than counter availability
evidence: Every3.2seconds, tick pops an NPC from remaining and starts its service/departure path.
When the final NPC is popped, called=True and Player called to check-in desk30 desk=01 are emitted immediately, before that NPC reaches or leaves its service position.
All authored NPC service paths include[-31.7,-14.6], corresponding to desk02; desk01 is at[-30.3,-10.6]. The marker claims both desks, while availability is not modeled per desk.
findings.correction: Use explicit counter assignment and service state. Advance one passenger into a genuinely free counter; call the player when an assigned counter is free and its approach is clear. Keep NPC and player guidance consistent with that counter.
acceptance: At each call, the indicated workstation and public approach are free of another passenger.
NPC service/exit motion cannot cross the player or other NPC without collision/avoidance.
Both desk numbers, queue sign, call and actual service position agree. Self-service kiosks may remain a clearly marked optional route.

findings.title: The current quality gate bypasses the systems now failing in the playable map
evidence: clarity37_review setup explicitly sets checked_in=True and bag_accepted=True, issues a ticket and teleports to[-42,-5.3,1.62] before its route checks.

The93 checks mostly verify predetermined waypoint arrival, selected furniture, two partition traces, stairs and boarding. They do not exercise current queue/check-in, baggage endpoint transfer, access denial, lavatory privacy, perimeter escape, or temporal stability.

The README discloses the after-check-in setup and references an older Terminal34 proof, so this is a coverage gap rather than fabricated evidence. New world geometry and inherited systems still require current end-to-end tests.
findings.correction: Add a current fresh-start journey and negative-path suite, plus per-finding visual/temporal checks. Keep focused route tests, but do not use their passing count as whole-map sign-off. Each repaired defect needs a reproduced-before and passing-after acceptance result.
acceptance: Fresh launch through entrance, real queue or kiosk, physical bag transfer, security, repacking, gate, bridge and cabin seat completes without setup-state flags or route teleports.
Negative cases cover denied entry/exit/boarding, occupied WC, boundary holes, outdoor phantom floors and stalled baggage.
Stationary/moving frame captures and supporting object transforms distinguish z-fighting/AA shimmer from physical motion; all five fix reports are traced to evidence.

coverage.entrancefoyer/checkin: Reviewed actual queue/call, optional kiosks, pickup/drop state and guide/HUD code; J04,J08,J09. Current check-in desks are not proven mutually overlapping; equipment reviewer found internal assembly/wall defects.
coverage.publicreturn/landsidecorridor: Current floor-envelope/fallback and physical access policy reviewed; J01,J02; architecture reviewer verifies west envelope seam.
coverage.security/recovery: Person traversal is real, but baggage scanner action is not connected to clearance and access policy is overridden; J01,J03,J04.
coverage.concourse/gate07foyer/gate08foyer: Cross-reviewed sign and coplanar roof findings; contextual A08 action mismatch J06. Do not diagnose remaining A08 flicker as a room XY-footprint mismatch.
coverage.gate07/gate08: Boarding conditions and gate-specific prompts reviewed; J06. Occupied bench filtering DOES exist in characters12_runtime and is not counted as an uncovered defect.
coverage.cafe/cafefoyer/gallery: Real stairs/eye-height controls are present. Coffee service has no physical outcome, J07. Detail and roof defects are covered by equipment/layout/render reviews.
coverage.amenitylobby/amenities: Cross-reviewed live exterior breach and floating/back-facing identifier; added explicit privacy-state defect J05.
coverage.arrivals/airside/jetbridge: Cross-reviewed orphan service ramp, obsolete floor and global deck fallback J02; shifted aircraft must have schema-aware point/navigation/boarding updates per airside review.
coverage.operations: Current staff-only lock is intentional policy; no staff credential is granted. This is not counted as a defect by itself. Staff sign/attachment and shelf readability issues belong to layout/equipment.

not_proven: No basis to say all props physically jitter: baseline scanner/bag transforms are invariant; ceiling image instability has a verified coplanar cause.
No missing occupied-seat guard: characters12_runtime filters and guards seated NPC locations.
No invalid assigned03E seat: Revision18 contains Economy seat03E12.
Staff-only access restriction can be intentional; do not unlock every room merely to make a review pass.
